short: Campus bells and emergency audio system
what: The whole campus safety platform: phone app, desk console, fobs, campus horns, and Alert Line (9090). Staff use it to ring class bells and declare Code Red or Code Blue.
usage: Say **Arnold Alert** when you mean the tool at alarm.arnoldcoc.org — not this playbook site.
notSameAs: Arnold Emergency (this website — the human SOP)

what: The live source of truth for who does what during Code Red or Code Blue. Markdown in git, published at emergency.arnoldcoc.org.
usage: Say **Arnold Emergency** when you mean procedures and roles — not the horn system.

what: The PIN-gated Progressive Web App at alarm.arnoldcoc.org. Add to iPhone Home Screen for one-tap access to codes, bells, and fob arm.
usage: Primary panic path on a phone — **Alert Emergency** panel for Code Red / Blue.

what: The management dashboard at alarm.arnoldcoc.org/desk/ — speakers, activity log, staff PINs, bells schedule, fobs, arm/standby.
usage: System Admins on a computer; not the first choice during an active crisis on your phone.

what: The big-button screen in Alert Mobile for Code Red, Code Blue, and All clear.
usage: Open Arnold Alert → sign in → **Alert Emergency** (requires Code Leader or System Admin PIN).

what: First Bell and Second Bell — play now or schedule to campus clock. Separate from emergency codes.
usage: Bell Ringer PIN only. Never use bells for lockdown or evacuate.

what: Arm/standby, volumes, speaker check, and mobile staff PIN management on a phone.
usage: System Admin scope on Alert Mobile.

short: Pair and arm a physical fob
what: Links a campus fob to your staff PIN and arms it for **3 hours**. Unarmed fobs do nothing when pressed.
usage: App → **Arm fob**, or Alert Line 9090 → press **4** → PIN. Re-arm every 3 hours.

what: Campus emergency code meaning **leave the building** and go to the assembly area. Red tone loops on campus horns until all clear.
usage: Fire, smoke, gas, structural hazard, or when the incident commander orders evacuation.

what: Campus emergency code meaning **shelter in place** — lock doors, lights off, silence phones. Blue tone loops until all clear.
usage: Threat inside the building or when IC orders lockdown. Do not evacuate unless IC or law enforcement says so.

what: Declares the emergency over. Plays Code Green tone ×2 on campus horns. Only available after Code Red or Blue was issued.
usage: **Incident commander or backup only.** Not for general staff or volunteers.

what: Collective name for Code Red, Code Blue, and All clear in Arnold Alert — the **Alert Emergency** panel and fob buttons.
usage: “Trigger an Alert Code” = declare Red or Blue through the system.

what: After you tap Code Red or Blue on a phone, a **10-second countdown** runs with a local phone alarm. Campus horns stay silent until you tap **Send now** or the timer hits zero.
usage: Lets you cancel a mistaken tap before the whole campus hears it.

what: The person who decides Red vs. Blue, ensures 911 is called, assigns nursery/class accountability, and **authorizes all clear**.
usage: Fill in names on the [Roles](/roles/) page. Backup IC assumes command if primary is unavailable.

what: UniFi Protect AI speakers in lobby, hallways, and fellowship hall. Play bells, emergency codes, and PA.
usage: Friendly name for “the speakers” in conversation with volunteers.

what: Carried devices: button **1** = Code Red, **2** = Code Blue, **4** = All clear. Registered in Alert Desk → System → Fobs.
usage: Must **Fob Arm** before buttons work. Activity log shows who had it armed.

what: The period when your assigned fob will actually trigger codes. Same 3-hour window as a normal app login session.
usage: Arm when you pick up a fob; re-arm if your shift is longer than 3 hours.

what: IVR menu on UniFi Talk: page, test, PIN codes, fob arm, system arm. Caller ID may show **Campus Security**.
usage: **Not** the primary way to declare a code in a crisis — use Alert Mobile or an armed fob. OK for paging (press 1) when appropriate.

what: Live paging to campus horns after a beep. For announcements — **not** lockdown or evacuate.
usage: Office convenience only. Never substitute for Code Red or Blue.

what: Declare Code Red or Blue from any phone with a staff evacuation PIN.
usage: Backup if you do not have Alert Mobile handy.

what: Direct dial to campus PA without the 9090 menu — beep then open mic.
usage: Facilities / staff who need fast paging. Still not for emergency codes.

what: Alert Notify (desk phones) → start tone → TEST ACOC on every horn. Run when building is empty.
usage: Alert Desk → Speaker test, or Alert Control on mobile.

short: Desk phone warning before horn test
what: Rings configured desk phones before speaker check horns. Press **0** on a desk phone to delay horns (tests only).
usage: Not an emergency feature — part of Alert Check workflow.

what: Normal operating state. Bells and emergency codes **sound on campus**. Default before services.
usage: Opposite of System Standby. Toggle in Alert Control, Alert Desk, or 9090 → 5.

what: Commands are **logged but held** — no audio on campus until a System Admin arms again.
usage: Maintenance, empty-building work, AV tests. Do not leave standby during public gatherings without reason.

what: Someone triggered a bell or code while the system was on standby. Logged in Desk Activity; horns did not play.
usage: Admin arms the system if the command should still run (usually review first).

what: Evacuation code is playing on campus horns. All clear is available; Code Blue is blocked until cleared.
Lockdown code is playing on campus horns. All clear is available; Code Red is blocked until cleared.
Permission for Alert Bells only. Cannot declare codes or open Alert Desk.
Permission for Alert Emergency, fobs, and Alert Line Codes. Cannot manage staff PINs or arm/standby.
Alert Desk, Alert Control, arm/standby, staff PIN management, speaker settings.
Queue plays from cellular when not on church Wi‑Fi. Grant sparingly.
Hashed PIN in Arnold Alert. Scopes control bells, codes, admin, or remote. Sessions last 3 hours idle.
usage: Never share your PIN. Temp PINs must be changed on first login.

what: Who triggered what and when — codes, bells, held commands, arm changes. Central time.
usage: Review after incidents: Alert Desk → Activity.

what: Single Start_Bell_Tone on all campus horns at bell volume.
Two Start_Bell_Tone plays on all horns (~1.5s apart).
Connects Arnold Alert cloud to UniFi Protect speakers on church LAN. Not used directly by most staff.
Phone menu path to toggle System Armed ↔ System Standby.
